notes.title: Akupara Games Celebrates 8 Year with Sales and Livestream
notes.content:
Hey Akuparians! Guess what, it’s our birthday!,

Akupara Games is turning 8 years old and to celebrate, we have put [i]The Crow's Eye[/i] on sale for 68% off! Be sure to grab those deals, check out our lovely event page, and check out the sales! Maybe the game you’ve been waiting for is waiting for you here, with a crisp sale to match. 
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/akuparagames8thanniversarysale 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27145360/1b810888a3baac10bb6e47830de98f6cfaa88b2c.png[/img]

Also, to celebrate, we will be hosting a multi-hour stream with tons of activities, announcements, and more! Stream is starting at 11:45 PM PDT! We really hope to see you there - and here’s to another year of publishing your favorite indie games on the market
https://www.twitch.tv/akuparagames  

- Riv otter

notes.title: Arima. A new adventure game from 3D2
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112450/Arima/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27145360/1fc06114b0e874be39db55f2f6a2b3747c27f76d.gif[/img][/url]

Arima is a musical game which narrative and objectives are visually and sound marked. It is an Adventure set in a fantastic world. The player will live an auditory experience, where the mechanics revolve around music.
[list]
[*] Battle system characterized by rhythm.
[*] Innovative mechanics based on rhythm.
[*] Environmental narrative without any text.
[*] Eye-catching artistic visual.
[/list]

Go check it and add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112450/Arima/
